sources.name: ABS Regional Labour Force, modelled SA4 estimates
sources.coverage: 87 labour market regions, January 2012 to September 2026, persons by age and sex rolled up
sources.note: First issue of Regional Labour Force, released 22 October 2026. The cube header still says ASGS 2011, but the region list matches ASGS Edition 3 with Western Australia - Outback (North) and (South) published as one combined region, code 508, as the ABS release notes.

sources.name: ABS Labour Force, unemployment rate by state
sources.coverage: Seasonally adjusted unemployment rate, persons aged 15 and over, Australia and states 1-6, January 2012 to September 2026
sources.note: Data API dataflow LF, key M13 (unemployment rate), sex 3, age 1599, TSEST 20, monthly. Region codes 7 and 8 (Northern Territory and Australian Capital Territory) returned no records for this key, so those two jurisdictions are read from the modelled SA4 estimates.

sources.name: ABS Job Vacancies by state
sources.coverage: Original job vacancies, total sectors and industries, states and Australia, 2012 Q1 to 2026 Q3, thousands
sources.note: Substitute for the Jobs and Skills Australia Internet Vacancy Index. The JSA download host did not return the September 2026 SA4 workbook (timed out, then HTTP/2 internal error) on 9 November 2026. ABS vacancies are quarterly and state-level, not SA4 job ads.

sources.name: ABS Building Approvals, dwelling units by state
sources.coverage: Number of dwelling units approved, total sectors, total residential, states and Australia, January 2015 to September 2026
sources.note: Data API dataflow BA_GCCSA, measure 1, value 1, sector 9, work type TOT, building type TOT, original.

sources.name: RBA cash rate target
sources.licence: RBA website statistics, attribution required; see note
sources.coverage: Cash rate target on the last published day of each month, from the daily F1 target series through 6 November 2026
sources.note: RBA Statistical Table F1 series FIRMMCRTD (cash rate target). Only this RBA series was copied. Other F1 columns, including bank-bill and swap rates sourced from ASX and market vendors, were not copied. The RBA permits reproduction of its website statistics with attribution; this series is not a third-party market yield.

sources.name: ASGS Edition 3 SA4 digital boundaries
sources.coverage: SA4 2021 boundaries, simplified for the web map. Outback North and South dissolved to region 508.
sources.note: Coastlines are simplified. This is a display file, not a legal boundary.
